title: Single-Cell Transcriptomics of Human Lymph Node Stroma
author: Takeda, Jalkanen
materials: LIVE/DEAD Fixable Near-IR Dead Cell Stain kit

steps.title: Prepare enzyme digestion mix
steps.instruction: Make 15 ml of enzyme mix using RPMI supplemented with 0.8 mg/ml Dispase, 0.2 mg/ml collagenase P and 0.1 mg/ml DNase for each tissue.

steps.title: Prepare PBS with supplements
steps.instruction: Prepare PBS containing 2 % fetal calf serum (FCS) and 2 mM EDTA.

steps.title: Prepare phenol‑red‑free DMEM
steps.instruction: Prepare phenol‑red‑free DMEM supplemented with 2 % FCS and 10 mM HEPES.

steps.title: Set centrifuge to 4 °C
steps.instruction: Adjust the centrifuge temperature setting to 4 °C.

steps.title: Coat tube with FCS
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml of FCS to each 1.5 ml tube, incubate for more than 12 hours to prevent cell adhesion.

steps.title: Slice lymph nodes and keep on ice
steps.instruction: Immediately after surgery, place lymph nodes in a 35 mm dish with 5 ml RPMI on ice and cut into ~0.5 mm³ cubes using fine scalpels.

steps.title: Digest tissue in enzyme mix (first incubation)
steps.instruction: Transfer the tissue pieces to a 15 ml tube containing 5 ml enzyme mix, incubate at 37 °C for a total of 20 min, gently inverting the tube 2–3 times every 5 min.

steps.title: Transfer fragments to cold PBS (supernatant 1)
steps.instruction: Pass the incubated pieces gently through a wide‑bore tip of a 1 ml pipette, let fragments settle for 30 s, then remove the enzyme mix and add it to a tube of cold PBS with 2 % FCS and 2 mM EDTA (supernatant 1).

steps.title: Second enzyme digestion (10 min)
steps.instruction: Add 5 ml fresh enzyme mix to the tube with the remaining fragments, incubate at 37 °C for 10 min, inverting the tube every 5 min.

steps.title: Collect supernatant 2 in cold PBS
steps.instruction: After the 10‑min incubation, mix fragments vigorously for 30 s with a wide‑bore 1 ml pipette tip, let them settle, remove the supernatant and transfer it to a new tube containing cold PBS with 2 % FCS and 2 mM EDTA (supernatant 2).

steps.title: Final enzyme digestion and combine suspensions
steps.instruction: Add another 5 ml fresh enzyme mix to the fragments, incubate at 37 °C until fragments are almost completely digested, mixing vigorously every 5 min (typically 2–4 times). Combine this suspension with supernatants 1 and 2.

steps.title: Centrifuge, filter, and re‑centrifuge cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the combined suspension at 300 g, 4 °C; filter the cell suspension through a 100 µm cell strainer; centrifuge the filtrate again at 300 g, 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend cells in phenol‑red‑free DMEM and count
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in phenol‑red‑free DMEM containing 2 % FCS and 10 mM HEPES, then count cells (typical viability ≈95 %).

steps.title: Count sorted cells and assess viability
steps.instruction: Manually count sorted stromal cells at least twice, assess viability with trypan blue, and record the data as metadata.

steps.title: Process samples per 10X Genomics guide
steps.instruction: Process the samples following the 10X Genomics User Guide.

steps.title: Prepare scRNA‑seq libraries (10X v2/v3)
steps.instruction: Prepare single‑cell RNA‑sequencing libraries according to the manufacturer’s instructions for 10X Genomics v2 or v3 chemistry.
